# VD Globals

> VD Globals is an authority advisory firm that helps founders and businesses build recognition, credibility, and trust through ethical PR, media strategy, and Wikipedia advisory. We diagnose the real problem before recommending anything, and we never guarantee outcomes that depend on independent third parties such as Wikipedia editors, journalists, or search engines.

VD Globals is remote and global, based in Texas, United States. Tagline: Authority. Recognition. Trust. Contact: vdglobals365@gmail.com.

## Core pages
- [About](https://vdglobals.com/about): The firm, its philosophy, and how it thinks about authority.
- [Solutions](https://vdglobals.com/solutions): Advisory across authority strategy, strategic PR, Wikipedia advisory, executive positioning, digital reputation, and thought leadership. Advisory-first, never predefined packages.
- [Authority Assessment](https://vdglobals.com/assessment): A complimentary evaluation of where a business stands across credibility, media presence, search visibility, and reputation.
- [Case Studies](https://vdglobals.com/case-studies): Real advisory engagements told as consulting summaries, showing how the firm diagnoses problems rather than selling services.
- [Contact](https://vdglobals.com/contact): Start a conversation or request an assessment.
